stories.headline: Anthropic Files S-1 for Landmark Public Debut
stories.blurb: Anthropic officially submitted its S-1 filing, revealing massive revenue growth and financial metrics as it prepares for one of tech's most anticipated AI public offerings.

stories.headline: Meta Launches $95 Billion Stock Offering for AI Growth
stories.blurb: Meta announced a massive $95 billion stock sale to fund aggressive, long-term capital investments in AI compute and hardware infrastructure.

stories.headline: Wall Street Consortium Launches $63 Billion AI Financing Deal
stories.blurb: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi, and Morgan Stanley partnered with Broadcom on a landmark $63 billion structure to finance enterprise AI compute deployment.

stories.headline: Microsoft Offers Buyouts to 60,000 Workers in AI Pivot
stories.blurb: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance to roughly 60,000 employees as the tech giant shifts operating budget away from headcount and directly into AI compute capacity.

stories.headline: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6.1 Terra
stories.blurb: OpenAI launched its GPT-6.1 Terra model alongside safety evaluations detailing red-teaming results and safeguard boundaries.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Patches Data Leak Bug in Workers AI
stories.blurb: Cloudflare disclosed and resolved a cross-request KV cache exposure flaw in its GLM-5.3 deployment that risked leaking user data across AI sessions.

stories.headline: Cohere Warns of Hazardous Behaviors in Open AI Models
stories.blurb: Cohere published findings highlighting concerning emergent behaviors and safety-bypassing capabilities in widely used open-weight foundation models.

stories.headline: OpenAI Unveils 'Dots' Always-On Developer Assistant
stories.blurb: OpenAI evolved its developer capabilities into 'dots,' a continuous, always-on personal assistant built into daily engineering workflows.

stories.headline: Intel Acquires Quantum Software Developer Classiq
stories.blurb: Intel agreed to buy Classiq to integrate high-level quantum software design into its hardware roadmap and build a full-stack quantum computing platform.

stories.headline: Entire Launches Git Forge for AI-Human Pair Programming
stories.blurb: Entire introduced a modern version-control platform optimized specifically to help software developers manage and co-author code generated by autonomous AI agents.

stories.headline: Nvidia Sidesteps JEDEC HBM Standards for AI Chips
stories.blurb: Nvidia is designing custom memory interconnects outside standard JEDEC specifications to bypass memory bandwidth bottlenecks on next-generation AI accelerators.

stories.headline: Microsoft Details Spec-Driven Legacy Code Modernization
stories.blurb: Microsoft shared architectural techniques for utilizing agentic software engineering to automate large-scale language migrations across legacy enterprise codebases.

stories.headline: Apple Announces Major iPad Mini Overhaul
stories.blurb: Apple unveiled significant design and hardware performance upgrades for the iPad mini to bring modern processing capabilities to its compact tablet line.
